_metadata.description: HMMWV 17 bodies converted from a Project Chrono::Vehicle JSON model
_metadata.author: chrono_convert.py

data_origin.detail: Converted from Project Chrono::Vehicle JSON files. Geometry, masses, inertias, spring and damper laws are the Chrono values; the SVJ origin and the ground plane are derived (see x_chrono.frame). Estimated values keep their Chrono origin and are not marked _est.

reference_pose.note: Chrono design configuration: hardpoints as given, springs at their installed length; Chrono states no load case

tire.description: Magic Formula Tire from ADAMS/Car TIR file (Chrono Pac02Tire)

frame.note: p_svj = p_chrono - shift; the Chrono chassis frame is the reference frame of the chassis body

meshes.note: Chrono mesh files as named in the Chrono JSON; the right-side rim and tyre are rotated pi about the spindle Z axis (ChWheel.cpp, ChTire.cpp)

steering.input: Chrono steering input s in [-1, 1], positive = left turn (ChSteering.h)

meshes.description: Chrono OBJ meshes converted by chrono_convert.py (chassis, rims, tyres)
